question: Will any state actor use chemical weapons in Ukraine before May 1, 2026?

synthesis: The objections identify credible downward pressures (deterrence and attribution ambiguity) alongside upward pressures (on-ground CS detections and escalation risk). Given near-term forecast signals, a two-year horizon plausibly yields a nonzero risk but substantially below the 40% ensemble, hence a calibrated probability around 0.23 with a broad but plausible range.
